title: UGO-Omics: an expression-backed orthogroup resource for comparative underground-organ biology
description: UGO-Omics is an expression-backed orthogroup resource and static web platform for comparative underground-organ biology. The release includes a static website, JSON browser layers, candidate tables, orthogroup summaries, figure source tables, Supplementary Tables S6-S9, benchmark recovery outputs, and manuscript-supporting materials.
